evidence.quote: The language of instruction is half German and half English.
The University of Duisburg-Essen does not charge tuition fees.
For the winter semester: 1 May - 15 June
For courses with admission restrictions (NC): 01 May - 15 June
Applications for bachelor's programs (including Medicine) are to be submitted through the uni-assist application portal.
German language skills B1 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: Goethe-Zertifikat: Goethe-Zertifikat B1
English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: IELTS Academic: 5.5

The special eligibility to study in the sense of sentence 1 is considered to be proven, if the applicant has taken mathematics in the last 3 years of the previous education, entitling him/her to direct university admission and has achieved a grade of 2.5 or better.

note.fr: Vérifier que le diplôme d'accès à l'université est reconnu comme équivalent à l'Abitur allemand.
note.en: Check that the university entrance qualification is recognized as equivalent to the German Abitur.

note.fr: Une note de 2,5 ou mieux en mathématiques au cours des trois dernières années est requise.
note.en: A grade of 2.5 or better in mathematics during the last three years is required.

evidence.quote: have graduated with a grade of 2.5 (German grading system) or better

notes: Tuition: no tuition fees, but a semester contribution is charged (about 350 EUR per DAAD page, about 320 EUR per UDE page); this is not tuition. Application deadlines: the quotes show day-month but the year is not for a specific application cycle; the DD.MM format was normalized with 2026 from the page context. The recurring German deadline 'International: 01.05. - 15.06.' applies to non-EU applicants, but the deadline for the winter semester is given without a year.
